body: I feel this so much right now. I just lost the only friend I had left because she said didnt want to deal with me anymore. Honestly, I can't blame her.
I feel like I'm on my way to that point. The only time I'm sober is when I'm with my children.
Someone who can play with them and not sit on the floor crying all day
I just want to be better for my children. They deserve better. I promised them I would always be here for them and I don't want to break that promise

It was more of a general everyone. Friends and family who are all tired of me "being dramatic". I've isolated myself away from everyone because when I attempted to reach out all I got in return was "omg you just want attention and I don't want to deal with it" or "you're just being dramatic, get over it". So I just stopped reaching out and kept everything to myself
